name: Mixed Document Type Pack (CORD + FUNSD)
description: 10 CORD Korean/Indonesian receipts + 10 FUNSD business correspondence. Tests adaptive policy routing across document types. Each case carries only type-specific fields.

fields.total_amount: Final total numeric amount on the receipt. Number only, no currency symbol. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
fields.subtotal_amount: Subtotal before tax. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
fields.tax_amount: Tax or service charge amount. Number only. May be labeled TAX, VAT, PB1, or other local tax codes. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
fields.cash_amount: Cash paid by customer. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
fields.change_amount: Change returned to customer. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.

fields.recipient: Full name of the person or organization the letter/memo is addressed to. May appear after To:, Dear, or in a header block.
fields.sender: Full name of the person who wrote or signed the letter/memo. May appear after From:, Sincerely, or as a signature.
fields.date: Date the letter or document was written. May be in any format (e.g. December 9, 1999 or 12/10/98).
